The '''VX "Sidewinder"''' was a type of [[Repeating blaster/Legends|Repeating blaster]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 3,350 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Its high rate of fire was due to its five rotating barrels.<ref name="DC" />
